answer: In Sybil equilibrium each Sybil locks collateral C with quadratic slashing k²C for k faults, so cluster expenditure scales super-linearly as n²C while extractable value grows linearly in n; since n²C>nV for all n≥2, marginal attack cost strictly dominates yield, rationalizing defection. Like a voyage whose copper toll at an oasis compounds per forged node, expense outruns surplus, sustaining protocol consensus.
